# Attribution ladders (generated by hand-run commands, not by the harness)

PRELIMINARY: every number below was taken on a machine whose 12 threads were 20-96% busy (a long LLM evaluation, load average ~11). Pinned to cpu 3 with taskset; ratios are the median of per-round pairs against the first row, followed by [min..max] of the pairs. Treat differences under about 15% as unresolved: the same binary spans 2.1..3.4 against its own reference in one table.

Method and commands: docs/PERFORMANCE.md section 3 and the recipe block at the end of this file.

## Recipe
```
idc emits C:        idc/bin/idc bench/id/NAME -o OUT --keep-c        (writes OUT.c, the single translation unit)
base (1TU):          gcc -std=c11 -O2 NAME.c [bench/id/lib/flt/msqrt.c -Ibench/id/lib/flt -lm]
inl:                 sed -i '/^static [A-Za-z_][^;=]*) *{/ s/^static /static inline /'      (what idc's unit mode does to the prelude)
nochk:               sed 's/if (i < 0 || i >= L->len) {/if (0) {/; s/if (!L) id_null_read(); //; s/id_list_mut_check(L); //'
konst:               conf scalars 'int x = 7;  /* constant from conf.id */' -> 'static const int x = 7;'
sqrt:                id_msqrt( -> __builtin_sqrt(
wp:                  add -fwhole-program
plainalloc:          delete the id_arena_link / id_arena_unlink calls
noexit:              id_arena_free_all returns at once
noovf:               #define id_add_check(a,b,w) ((a)+(b)); id_mul_check likewise
O3n:                 -O3 -march=native
timing:              alternate the rungs round-robin on one core, 5-7 rounds, compare stdout hashes
```
